name: SBS Transit Ltd

scam_info.sample: SCAM ALERT: If you receive a message claiming you've won a prize from SBS Transit, please delete it immediately as it's not from us. A fake SBS Transit app has also been found on parallel app stores.
scam_info.notes: Homepage scam-alert banner (undated): fake prize messages and a fake SBS Transit app on 'parallel app stores' (no app name/store given) - 'Only download or update our app through the official Apple App Store or Google Play Store.' Points to ScamShield helpline 1799. /security page (HTTP 200) is about transit security, no scam content.

apps: SBS Transit Mobile App (official Apple App Store / Google Play only, per homepage)

notes: official_domains (b): serves site. robots.txt (13 KB, many Disallow lines, no Sitemap line). Fake-app warning is the only scam content; 'app' in lists_indicators refers to the existence of a fake app, not a named one. No dated advisory list.
